content: {"episode_id":"ep-05058","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient presenting with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. The patient also has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), which heightens the clinical need to identify a cardiac rhythm disturbance. Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered specifically to correlate the patient's symptoms with potential arrhythmic events, as documented in the clinical indication note. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
